claim_boundary: Recovery of an experimentally established positive control calibrates known-positive capture; it does not establish presentation, TCR binding, activation, cross-reactivity, molecular mimicry, or MS disease mechanism for discovery candidates.
denominator_rule: Exact peptide identities and HLA arms, same human T-cell clone cross-recognition, and experimental pMHC structures for both arms
interpretation: The frozen method captured the one independent experimentally established system. Broad sensitivity and generalization cannot be estimated from one system.
